name: AI News Daily
audience: People who follow technology — software, AI and hardware (developers, students, founders, curious professionals, India and worldwide) and want one short daily catch-up of what actually happened in the last 24 hours
titleFormula: <the day's 2-3 biggest stories or names> | Tech News Last 24 Hours | <D Mon YYYY>
titleExamples: OpenAI's New Model, Apple M5 Macs & Windows Outage | Tech News Last 24 Hours | 14 Oct 2026
notes: Daily technology news roundup: software, AI and hardware, English, neutral male narrator (built-in TTS speaker). Tone: calm, fast, factual news anchor; no hype words, no 'guys'.
